conclusion: The current tree has a tested cell-stage slice with a clean input-to-sim bridge, but it does not contain the original editor or general UTFWin UI runtime. Static Ghidra/SDK evidence identifies Editors::cEditor as the editor interaction root, Simulator::cGameInputManager as the input/mode boundary, App::cMessageManager and UTFWin::Window as message/UI boundaries, and Anim::IAnimManager plus EditorCreatureController/cEditorAnimWorld as the pose and animation boundary. The cell slice currently routes SDL input directly to CellSim; it does not route the original IGameMode input callbacks or animation state into the renderer.

cell_interactive.transform: SDL scancodes are mapped to layout-stable CellInput keys; the keyboard state is polled rather than routed through IGameMode callbacks.
Frame thrustLeft/Right/Forward/Back and boost are copied; the last mouse position is copied as NDC hasMouse/mouseX/mouseY.
The app applies yaw/pitch/zoom steps, clamps pitch and zoom, and writes absolute camera values only when changed.
Camera input, turn, mouse ray-plane target, flee, target velocity, damping, integration, eat, camera follow, and event recording occur in the pinned order.
Player/background/entity positions are transformed into frame meshes; beginPresentFrame/drawTextured/drawMesh/endPresentFrame submit to the swapchain.

editor_static.transform: The original has a central input manager with mode/current-mode fields, maps, mouse fields, input regions, and key/mouse callback slots; exact input-region routing is not yet reconstructed.
OnMouseMove stores the editor pointer, x/y and active flag; OnMouseDown enters a drag/tool path; OnKeyDown first calls GameInput and then dispatches editor commands, commit/undo, and mode changes.
The editor queries renderer/shadow-world layers, performs hit/selection work, routes through active tool vtables, and commits the edit history.

The event object is packed into a local message-like structure and sent through an IAppSystem virtual call; Send uses the recovered Init slot and Post uses the recovered InitPlugins slot. The local type label is decompiler-sensitive.

in_tree_cell_mode.effects: Loads CellUI, initializes CellGfx/world slots, resets background clear and frame/input observability, sets mInitialized.
Increments mFrame; the original per-frame body is not present in this abstraction.
Resets background clear globals and clears mEntered.
Clears UI rollover pool, GFX display/worlds/preloads, frame and lifecycle flags.

cell_simulation.effects: Applies absolute camera values, then left/right turn before mouse target.
Mouse target is primary; keys add reduced secondary bias. Without mouse, keyboard thrust is the target path.
Faces away, boosts, emits flee, and overrides target velocity.
Damps velocity, integrates position, culls nearby food, increments growMeter, follows camera, increments frame and records events.

editor_static.effects: Stores the current editor and mouse coordinates, marks movement active, and delegates according to editor mode/tool state.
Checks lock/selected tool/shadow world, obtains renderer layer data, constructs tool objects, and routes mouse-button-specific edits.
Finalizes the interaction, updates history, may call Undo, clears active tool state, and can emit a message/animation event.
Cleans prior mode, updates cEditorAnimWorld target position/angle and creature controller state, enters the new mode, and emits MessageSend.

original_static_contract.mode_routing: The manager has mLastGameMode and mCurrentGameMode fields in the committed interface dossier, plus maps, mouse fields, and input regions. The exact region-to-mode routing remains uncharacterized.
original_static_contract.game_input: GameInput::OnKeyDown/OnKeyUp are SDK-named and directly manipulate a 32-bit bit-set for codes below 0x100 in the recovered body; decompiler calling-convention warnings make the field/parameter interpretation noisy.
original_static_contract.editor_callbacks: cEditor::OnKeyDown calls GameInput::OnKeyDown before editor command dispatch; cEditor::OnMouseMove stores coordinates; OnMouseDown/OnMouseUp use MouseButton, mouseX, mouseY and MouseState parameters.

current_clean_room_contract.frame: thrustLeft/right/forward/back and boost are emitted from held keys in src/apps/CellInput.cpp:48-75
current_clean_room_contract.camera: arrow direction is held-state only; the app owns yaw/pitch/zoom step magnitudes and clamps in src/apps/cell_stage.cpp:1102-1130
current_clean_room_contract.mouse: last motion is converted to NDC and marked persistent in src/apps/cell_stage.cpp:1007-1018

ui_to_gameplay_bridges.semantics: Mouse coordinates and button state are transformed through renderer/shadow-world layer data into tool-specific edit operations. The active tool pointer and its vtable are the bridge.

ui_to_gameplay_bridges.evidence: Ghidra read-only decompilation of Editors::EditorPlayMode::OnMouseDown at 0x0062a820
ui_to_gameplay_bridges.semantics: The function loops an actor array and ORs the result of each actor callback. This is a concrete gameplay-interaction fan-out boundary, but exact actor types and message semantics remain unresolved.
Mode changes and editor state updates target creature position/angle. The controller exposes current/real target position, target angle, movement speed and rotation speed in the SDK field export.

ui_to_gameplay_bridges.path: EditorAnimWorld_PlayAnimation -> creature map -> AnimatedCreature vtable slot 0x04
ui_to_gameplay_bridges.semantics: The world looks up the creature ID, finds its EditorCreatureController, then calls the AnimatedCreature PlayAnimation slot when both controller and creature exist.
The event packs editor model/event parameters and invokes an app-system message dispatch slot. The Send/Post distinction is observable; the exact message object type and queue priority are not.

ui_to_gameplay_bridges.path: SDL scancode state -> CellInput::Frame -> CellSim::InputFrame -> CameraState/PlayerState
ui_to_gameplay_bridges.semantics: This bridge is implemented and deterministic. Keyboard is secondary when a mouse target exists; without a mouse, keyboard thrust is the fallback.
Position, heading, culled entity state and camera matrices are baked into per-frame meshes. There is no animation or pose stream in this bridge.

sdk_animation_surface.vtable: 32 slots include PlayAnimation, LoadAnimation, SetAnimationMode, SetAnimationIdle, SetAnimationBlendInTime, StartAnimation, SetLoop, SetLoopTimes, SetAnimationID, GetCurrentAnimation, GetAnimationLength and GetAnimWorld.

sdk_animation_surface.semantics: The message record is the clearest SDK boundary between animation dispatch and a creature/pose target. The current tree does not model this record.

sdk_animation_surface.vtable: AddRef, Release, DrawLayer, SetEffectWorld, SetModelWorld, Dispose, Update, UpdateCreatures, PostUpdateCreatures, LoadCreature, LoadCreatureByName, DestroyCreature and GetCreatures.

cell_animation_surface.sdk_enum: CellAnimations is a 32-bit enum; the export includes kAnimIndexCellIdle, movement, eat, damage, death, mood, and NPC variants.
cell_animation_surface.cell_object_fields: cCellObjectData stores mTargetOrientation at 0x14, mTransform at 0x48, mCurrentAnimation at 0x1b0, field_1B4 at 0x1b4, field_1B8 at 0x1b8 and mGFXObjectIndex at 0x248 in the SDK export; the clean-room src/sim/CellPool.hpp exposes the same named subset.
cell_animation_surface.current_tree: src/apps/CellAnim.hpp:26-86 models only CellAnimations, blend in/out times, effect-map slot selection, event-to-effect IDs and effect instance parameter placement. src/apps/CellAnim.cpp:7-82 implements those pure transformations. The current cell_stage main/runInteractive path has no call to animBlend, instanceEffect or effectIDForEvent; only src/apps/cellanim_test.cpp exercises them.
cell_animation_surface.pose_gap: The current renderer draws static baked meshes with position/heading and no skeleton, bone, morph, blend-shape, animation-time or pose-stream contract. The current CellSim PlayerState has heading and position but no pose/animation state.

editor_anim_event_semantics.send: cEditorAnimEvent::MessageSend at 0x0059d8b0 packs editorModel, eventID, event object, and scalar parameters then calls the recovered IAppSystem Init slot.
editor_anim_event_semantics.post: cEditorAnimEvent::MessagePost at 0x0059d840 performs the same pack and calls the recovered IAppSystem InitPlugins slot.
editor_anim_event_semantics.neutral_pose: cEditor::SetCreatureToNeutralPose at 0x00573970 emits MessagePost when the editor neutral-pose condition is active, then stores a 250.0-like float sentinel and releases the temporary event object; exact meaning of the sentinel is unresolved.
editor_anim_event_semantics.commit: cEditor::CommitEditHistory at 0x00586410 appends state/model history, updates UI state, and may destroy/recreate editor anim-world creatures; this is a pose/model synchronization boundary, not merely a UI event.

event_message_boundaries.name: Win32 message pump
event_message_boundaries.boundary: PeekMessageW/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessageW/WM_QUIT feeds a vtable frame-render slot; this is below editor/gameplay code and is not reproduced in src.

event_message_boundaries.name: App message manager
event_message_boundaries.boundary: IMessageListener/IMessageManager provide message IDs, standard messages with five MessageParameter slots, handler/object entries, priority, locking and queue processing. The exact dispatch order and message-ID constants are not yet characterized.
event_message_boundaries.status: static API plus partial queue mechanics

event_message_boundaries.name: UTFWin window messages
event_message_boundaries.boundary: IWindow has 71 vtable slots; Window owns manager, parent/children lists, WinProc list, control/command IDs, real area, area, cursor ID, state flags, caption and font ID. SendMsg delegates through window-proc vtable state, but the recovered pseudocode is not type-safe enough to name every slot.
event_message_boundaries.status: static framework structure; runtime grammar unresolved

event_message_boundaries.name: editor message dispatcher
event_message_boundaries.boundary: The function is a large message-ID switch that reaches editor UI, property access, game mode manager, renderer layers, resource/model helpers, edit history, mode switching, and cEditorAnimEvent::MessageSend. The decompiler comparison of this/message arguments is noisy; exact IDs and payload schemas remain open.

event_message_boundaries.name: pdtk UI command boundary
event_message_boundaries.boundary: UTFWin text widgets build pdtk_text_new/select/focus/icursor command strings and update widget size/cursor. The pdtk grammar has no SDK symbols and is not part of the current renderer interface.

event_message_boundaries.name: space event records
event_message_boundaries.boundary: This separate space-mode event builder emits two records with object refs, cell IDs, millisecond timestamp, slot sentinel, IDs and float3 positions. It demonstrates that event records are mode-specific and not a universal SimEvent ABI.
event_message_boundaries.status: inferred static evidence; layout not in SDK TSV
